children: UK payments infrastructure provider OpenPayd is seeking to enter the US stock market this year. The company plans to accelerate its US expansion and pursue additional acquisitions.

OpenPayd Chief Executive Officer Iana Dimitrova told CoinDesk on Oct. 4 that the US Securities and Exchange Commission's review of its merger with special purpose acquisition company Titan Acquisition is in its final stages. Unless there is a major external shock, the merger can be completed this year. OpenPayd plans to complete its Nasdaq listing by year-end.

Titan Acquisition is the SPAC that OpenPayd is merging with to list on the Nasdaq. Once the deal closes, OpenPayd will trade under the ticker OP. The company is targeting a valuation of about $1.1 billion.

OpenPayd plans to use proceeds from the listing first to expand its US business. The company aims to launch services in the US by April 2027. Last month, it acquired money transmitter licenses in 43 US states, securing a foundation for local operations.

After the listing, the company also plans to step up mergers and acquisitions. Dimitrova said OpenPayd is interested in businesses where acquiring technology or licenses would help it bring products to market faster. The company is also considering a private placement to raise growth capital ahead of the merger.

OpenPayd is a payments infrastructure platform that supports the movement of funds between fiat currencies and stablecoins. Crypto exchanges OKX and Kraken, along with market makers, use its infrastructure. Dimitrova described OpenPayd as global infrastructure for modern money movement. She added that no listed competitor offers the same combination of fiat and stablecoin capabilities.

title: UK's OpenPayd Seeks Nasdaq Listing This Year Through Titan SPAC Merger, Speeds US Expansion
